name: FindLevelEntry
evidence: walks the 33 LevelEntry records of D_00248748 and returns the one whose first word equals its argument, or 0

name: InitCommentaryPromptElement
evidence: after SetupScreenElementText looks up the current level's entry (FindLevelEntry) to set world fields, then on bit 8 of D_002623C8 shows the string "Press &2L&. for Bonus Commentary" with a 5-second hold

name: UpdateBestTimeState
evidence: per-frame update of the same object: in states 0/1 hides its text after a button request or 5 seconds, in state 2 keeps the timer display and best-time marker in step, ending with SetBestTimeState(3) when the timer stops

name: SetBestTimeState
evidence: state 0..3 setter: on 2 starts the timer display and shows 'Best time' text or a begin text, on 3 compares the timer with the stored best time (D_002623C8), updates it and the memory card and plays a result sound; stores the state and the clock

name: DrawFramedText
evidence: when the text is non-empty sets the font scale, scales the colour alpha by blend, draws the optional frame box (self->frame) and then the text with the same placement

name: FinishBestTimeRun
evidence: calls SetBestTimeState with state 3, which compares the timer with the stored best time; func_001F4808 calls it

name: ConstructBestTimeTextStyle
evidence: the file's static initialiser: builds the text style the best-time commentary draws with (cleared, kind 0x2D, two integer sizes, 0.3 twice, colour); g_commentaryFrameStyle is it

name: ConstructBestTimeTextStyleAtStartup
evidence: the file's _GLOBAL_$I$: calls ConstructBestTimeTextStyle with (1, 0xFFFF); an entry of the startup init-list D_0027B130
